doc_verification.detail: Reachability: no doc_preflight.json sidecar exists in the contract directory; live WebFetch of https://api.qdrant.tech/v-1-18-x/api-reference/query/query-points-groups was blocked by the environment (domain_blocked — PARTIAL, not FAIL); the contract itself recorded source_status='reachable' at build time. Version: versioned v-1-18-x api-reference route vs target v1.18.0 — major.minor match. Content: live page not re-verifiable; the pipeline's build-time extraction from this exact page (raw_knowledge.json L1693/L1703-1706: group_by 'payload field to group by; requires payload values'; L1813: 'requires payload values for group_by; ... 200 {groups: [{id, hits}]}; 404; 400 invalid group_by') matches the contract assertion verbatim in substance, so the contract faithfully encodes what the doc said when reachable. Endpoint: endpoint_registry carries points+query+groups POST with the same source_url (structured_contract.json L2207/L5506); the log requests hit that same face (Cvalid leg returns the {groups:[{id,hits}]} shape).

grpc/sdk face: face_unavailable for direct probing in this sandbox (REST-only probe); source forensics shows REST and gRPC converge on the same internal CollectionQueryGroupsRequest (lib/collection/src/operations/universal_query/collection_query.rs L71: 'Internal representation of a group query request, used to converge from REST and gRPC'), so the absent group_by-existence validation is shared by construction across faces

http_semantics.note: Actually stricter than the named category: a request-side-decidable defect (group_by naming a field no point has payload values for) returned HTTP 200 with a plain success envelope (status:'ok', groups=[]) — no business error code of any kind, i.e. a fully silent success rather than a 2xx-with-error-code or a 4xx.

contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: grouping requires payload values for the group_by field; returns 200 {groups: [{id, hits}]}; 400 on an invalid group_by; 404 for a missing collection
contract_grounding.note: Violates-declaration self-check: the observed phenomenon is exactly 'illegal value silently accepted' (200 + status ok + groups=[]) and the quote pins a 400 disposition. The observed group_by ('definitely_missing_field_xyz', a field no point has payload values for) is INSIDE the quote's constraint domain — the assertion's own first clause ('grouping requires payload values for the group_by field') makes payload-value presence part of group_by validity, so a no-payload-values field is an invalid group_by and the pinned disposition 400 applies; observed 200 contradicts it. This is not a wrong-constraint-citation case: the syntactic faces of the same parameter (omitted/empty path/wrong type) do return 400 per the assertion, confirming the constraint governs this parameter.

files_examined: lib/collection/src/grouping/group_by.rs (full read — the deciding code path)
lib/api/src/rest/schema.rs (BaseGroupRequest L1115-1125 / QueryBaseGroupRequest L1202-1214 — validate attributes)
lib/collection/tests/integration/grouping_test.rs (grep for missing-group_by behavior: zero hits — no test pins the no-payload-values disposition)
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST POST /collections/{c}/points/query/groups -> actix/validator on QueryBaseGroupRequest (serde: JsonPath syntax only — rejects missing field / empty path / non-string, the observed 400 legs; runtime validate attribute present ONLY on group_size range(min=1), the observed 422; group_by has NO runtime validator) -> src/common/query.rs do_query_point_groups L320 -> TableOfContent::group (lib/storage/src/content_manager/toc/point_ops.rs L240-260: auth check + get_collection — the source of the working 404 face) -> GroupRequest::from(CollectionQueryGroupsRequest) (group_by.rs L267-307, no validation) -> QueryGroupRequest::r#do (group_by.rs L144-178): silently merges Filter::new_must_not(Condition::IsEmpty(group_by)) into the source query filter — for a field with no payload values anywhere, every point fails the filter, 0 points returned, aggregator loop breaks on points.is_empty(), distill() yields empty groups -> HTTP 200 {groups: []}. The only group_by-related check in the tree is strict-mode check_grouping_field (lib/collection/src/operations/verification/mod.rs L372-396): it requires an INDEX on group_by and only when strict mode sets unindexed_filtering_retrieve=false (off by default; sandbox runs default config) — it checks index existence, never payload-value presence, and it is not on the default request path.
source_grounding.verification_outcome_reasoning: No code anywhere on the request path validates that the group_by field exists in the payload schema or that any point holds a payload value for it; the 200-with-empty-groups disposition is the mechanical consequence of implementing grouping as a must_not-IsEmpty filtered query. The nearest annotation (aggregator.rs 'ignore points that don't have the group_by field') documents per-point skip mechanics only — it does not declare the request-level 200-empty disposition for a wholly-absent field intentional, so by_design_in_source is not available under the tightened explicit-intent rule; no test in grouping_test.rs pins this disposition either.

excluded: env/endpoint-down: positive control leg Cvalid in the same run returned 200 with a correctly-formed group over 'grp' — endpoint, collection, and grouping machinery alive

request-parameter typo/malformed-syntax: the syntactic 400 legs (omitted/''/123/null) prove malformed group_by values are caught upstream; the accepted request passed all syntactic gates and reached semantic processing
concurrency/cache race: sequential deterministic requests; identical outcome across 4 scripts, 3 separately-seeded collections, and 3 different missing-field names
collection-missing confusion: D2 leg shows a missing collection yields 404 on this same endpoint — the 200 came from an existing collection
mundane_explanation.surviving: Undocumented-by-design tolerance cannot be fully excluded as a maintainer stance (grouping-as-filtered-search is a coherent design), but the source carries no explicit intent evidence for accepting a no-payload-values group_by with 200-empty, while the versioned documentation (via build-time extraction) pins 'requires payload values' + '400 on an invalid group_by' — the doc/implementation divergence survives mundane exclusion and is the auditor's question
